hints.title: Bounded Length Property
hints.text: Notice that forbidden strings have length at most 10.

hints.title: Restricting Window Boundary
hints.text: Moving from right to left, if word[left:end+1] is forbidden, the right boundary cannot extend beyond end - 1.

hints.title: Constant Checks Per Position
hints.text: From each index, check substrings of length up to 10 in a hash set to tighten the right bound.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: m: total characters in forbidden strings
complexity.notes: Sliding window with bounded substring checks up to maximum forbidden length 10.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substrings of a long string produces cubic or quadratic complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * 10) time using bounded length checks and O(m) space for the forbidden set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exploit the small constraint on forbidden word lengths to achieve linear time.
